name: TransportationInsecurityScreeningAssessmentsQuestions
title: Transportation Insecurity Screening Assessments Questions
purpose: (Clinical Focus: This set of values represents screening assessment questions for Transportation Insecurity as selected by the Gravity Project.),(Data Element Scope: This set of values may be used to represent screening assessment questions in observations, questionnaires, and questionnaire responses for this SDOH domain (e.g., for the SDOHCC Observation Screening Response profile in the Gravity SDOH Clinical Care FHIR Implementation Guide).),(Inclusion Criteria: Includes LOINC codes for SDOH screening assessment questions as selected by the Gravity Project.),(Exclusion Criteria: Excludes the questions not selected by the Gravity Project from SDOH screening assessments.)

concept.display: Has lack of transportation kept you from medical appointments, meetings, work, or from getting things needed for daily living during assessment period [CMS Assessment]
How often did you spend a long time waiting because you did not have the transportation that would allow you to come and go when you wanted
How often you were late getting somewhere because of a problem with transportation
How often did it take you longer to get somewhere than it would have taken you if you had different transportation
How often did you have to arrive somewhere early and wait because of the schedule of the bus, train, or person giving you a ride
How often did you have to reschedule an appointment because of a problem with transportation
How often did you skip going somewhere because of a problem with transportation
How often were you not able to leave the house when you wanted to because of a problem with transportation
How often did you worry about whether or not you would be able to get somewhere because of a problem with transportation
How often did you feel stuck at home because of a problem with transportation
How often do you think that someone did not invite you to something because of problems with transportation
How often did you feel like friends, family, or neighbors were avoiding you because you needed help with transportation
How often did you feel left out because you did not have the transportation you needed
How often did you feel bad because you did not have the transportation you needed
How often did you worry about inconveniencing your friends, family, or neighbors because you needed help with transportation
How often did problems with transportation affect your relationships with others
How often did you feel embarrassed because you did not have the transportation you needed
6-item Transportation Security Index total score [TSI-6]
16-item Transportation Security Index total score [TSI-16]
Access to transportation/mobility status [CUBS]
Has lack of transportation kept you from medical appointments, meetings, work, or from getting things needed for daily living
Do you have trouble finding or paying for transportation [WellRx]
Went without health care due to lack of transportation in last 12 months
Delayed medical care due to distance or lack of transportation
